sharedBuildTools.remaining: Final monorepo composition supplies the singular root tools file and packages/waffle libc/scanner sources.

installer.rule: Wire actual family exports, /usr/bin canonical paths and declared /bin aliases after Waffle step 2; do not import Bash installers.

browserHarness.rule: Keep shared harness and shell-runtime fixtures singular; family scripts/tests are source transfers until composition exists.

ownShellSourceChecks.rule: Transferred test-own-shell-* scripts retain their frozen cases and oracles but still need the singular harness and family artifact caller wiring. No scoreboard, parser, runtime or worker source is transferred.

notices.consumer: Existing browser aggregation remains outside the family.

env.rule: The frozen 9ef packaging assertions are transfer source only; final env integration remains with the sole env author.
